paragraphs.zh: 中，然后30℃保温5小时后，将反应液中的N，N-二甲基甲酰胺减压蒸除后，将残液加入300mL水中，用35％的盐酸调pH至弱酸性，冷却结晶，过滤，水洗，干燥得化合物II，称重得318.3g，收率92％。
paragraphs.en: into, then after holding at 30 degrees C for 5 hours, the N,N-dimethylformamide in the reaction liquid is distilled off under reduced pressure, the residual liquid is added into 300 mL of water, the pH is adjusted to weakly acidic with 35% hydrochloric acid, cooled to crystallise, filtered, washed with water and dried to give compound II, weighed at 318.3 g, yield 92%.
paragraphs.notes: Continuation block: this block carries no [00NN] marker of its own. It is the tail of the paragraph that begins on the previous page (p06), which the first word 中 ("into") confirms - the sentence starts mid-clause. The intra-name comma of N,N-dimethylformamide is printed as a full-width comma (N，N-), preserved verbatim.

paragraphs.zh: 步骤b：取1mol上述反应所得的化合物II，溶解在1000mL的环己烷中，然后在20-30℃温度条件下，半小时内加入含1.1mol(106.7g)1，3-环己二酮(化合物III)和1.8mol(291.6g)缩合剂CDI以及5mol(690g)碳酸钾，再在20-30℃温度条件下搅拌反应15小时，然后经过水洗、减压浓缩、加甲醇打浆、过滤、干燥得到成品环磺酮(化合物IV)355.5g，纯度96.3％，收率83.9％。
paragraphs.en: Step b: take 1 mol of compound II obtained from the above reaction, dissolve it in 1000 mL of cyclohexane, then at a temperature of 20-30 degrees C add, over half an hour, 1.1 mol (106.7 g) of 1,3-cyclohexanedione (compound III) together with 1.8 mol (291.6 g) of the condensing agent CDI and 5 mol (690 g) of potassium carbonate; stir and react for a further 15 hours at 20-30 degrees C, then wash with water, concentrate under reduced pressure, slurry with added methanol, filter and dry to obtain the finished product tembotrione (compound IV), 355.5 g, purity 96.3%, yield 83.9%.
paragraphs.notes: The locant comma in 1，3-环己二酮 is printed as a full-width comma in the scan and is kept as printed. 环磺酮 is the Chinese common name for sulcotrione; translated as such, no structure is drawn on this page to confirm it. Two literal figures worth flagging without resolving them: 106.7 g for 1.1 mol implies a molar mass near 97 for 1,3-cyclohexanedione, while 291.6 g / 1.8 mol (162) and 690 g / 5 mol (138) are internally consistent for CDI and potassium carbonate respectively. Recorded as printed, not corrected. Solvent is 环己烷 (cyclohexane), distinct from the reagent 环己二酮 (cyclohexanedione); the two words differ by one character in the scan and both were read carefully. Translation corrected during the run: the vision read glossed 环磺酮 as 'sulcotrione'. 环磺酮 is tembotrione. Sulcotrione is 磺草酮, a different triketone lacking the trifluoroethoxymethyl group, C14H13ClO5S vs C17H16ClF3O6S. Fixed from structure, not from a name lookup: the product this patent forms is 1,3-cyclohexanedione acylated by 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoic acid, which is tembotrione and cannot be sulcotrione. Chinese left verbatim.
